business_review.criterion: AC1: with member spend limit enforcement off, a member with a fixed override keeps their own override cap in LiteLLM until the override is deleted
AC2: overrides already broken in production are repaired after deploy
business_review.notes: Changed after review by decision: the automatic cap_rule_version resync was removed. The 10 broken overrides, found with the SQL in the MR description, are repaired by hand after deploy by re-saving each override

business_review.criterion: AC3: every project member's spend shows on the project members admin page
business_review.notes: UI fetches every page; backend orders members by user_id so pages are stable

business_review.criterion: Equal-share members in a project with enforcement off can still use the whole project budget

standards_review.notes: Commit subjects in both repos follow EPMCDME-16529: Capital sentence
Each sync call site asserts effective_max_budget at the provider boundary; the new tests fail without the fix
make ruff clean; UI eslint, prettier and tsc clean

findings.problem: clear_member_override pushed the shared child budget's stored amount, not the project max, when enforcement is off
findings.impact: After enforcement is switched on and off, the shared child row can still hold a per-member share; clearing an override then caps all equal members at one share until the following rebalance succeeds
findings.recommendation: With enforcement off, push the project max to the shared budget; with enforcement on, keep the shared share

findings.problem: The cap_rule_version gate forces one resync for every runtime-synced member after deploy, including equal-share members whose cap rule did not change
findings.impact: One extra provider sync on each member's first request per project and category after deploy; idempotent, no steady-state cost
findings.recommendation: Accept, or narrow the gate to fixed allocations, which needs the allocation mode in the resolved budget context

findings.problem: A stale multi-page fetch can abort a newer project member spending fetch
findings.impact: Only for projects with more than 1000 members: switching project mid-fetch can leave the new project's spend column empty until reload
findings.recommendation: Check the request generation between pages, or after response.json() in fetchWithState

findings.problem: Older reset tests did not stub the project enforcement lookup that reset_project_budget now calls
findings.impact: They passed only because the unstubbed lookup resolves to False in the test environment
findings.recommendation: Pin SettingsService.get_enforce_member_spend_limits in the project budget service tests

findings.problem: Broken overrides repair only on the member's next request through the codemie proxy or LLM factory
findings.impact: A member who spends against LiteLLM outside those paths keeps the wrong cap until a rebalance or enforcement toggle
findings.recommendation: Accept; check the affected rows with the SQL in the MR description after deploy

rationale: The change fixes the production root cause: with enforcement off, every member sync pushed the project max, so a fixed override's LiteLLM budget was overwritten with the project cap. A single helper now decides the pushed cap at every sync call site, and the project members page fetches every page of spending. No high or medium findings; CR-1 and CR-4 were patched and confirmed in the follow-up check, CR-3 is accepted as a known limitation. After review, the automatic cap_rule_version resync was removed in favour of repairing the 10 known broken overrides by hand, which makes CR-2 and CR-5 obsolete.

finding_status.note: automatic repair removed; broken overrides are repaired by hand
